html:
"Moravians" is the map's label, for 700, for the Slavic tribes along the Morava river, in what is now the eastern Czech Republic and western Slovakia.

Slavs settled here in the 500s and lived under the shadow of the Avars on the Hungarian plain. When Charlemagne broke Avar power in the 790s, the Moravian chiefs gained room to grow. Frankish and Bavarian priests brought Christianity. About 833 a ruler named Mojmír joined Moravia with the land around Nitra, founding Great Moravia. His successor invited Cyril and Methodius in 863. To the west lived the Czechs.
sum: "Moravians" is the map's label, for 700, for the Slavic tribes along the Morava river, in what is now the eastern Czech Republic and western Slovakia.
